==Behind the scenes==
Cyclea Station was mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[May]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. The feature was authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]].<ref name="Journal13" />
